messages:
nova_tech (customer): Hey folks — we finished the SSO + invite flow but our API key never showed up in the Console. Calls to embeddings return 403. Org name: nova-health, primary contact alice@novatech.com. Can someone check provisioning?

maria (support): sorry for the trouble — can you paste the curl you ran and the exact 403 payload? also screenshot of the org page would help.

nova_tech (customer): pasted below — response is immediate: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings\" -d '{"input":"test"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{\"error\":\"api_key_not_found\", \"message\":\"No API key associated with project 'default'\"}
```
We never got an API key email either. We only see the org created and one project with slug `nova-default`.

maria (support): thanks. I pulled the onboarding webhook for org `nova-health` — the `provision_api_key` job failed with an internal error: `missing_project_mapping`. Pinging @lia and @jon to help triage.

lia (solutions): seeing this pattern — sometimes the SCIM/invite flow creates an external project slug that doesn't map to an internal project id the provisioning job expects. quick workaround: you can create a key from Console and attach it to the project's permissions so your engineers can continue. steps: Console -> Settings -> API Keys -> Create key -> assign project `nova-default` (or whatever your main project is). or via CLI: 
```
# create key and attach to project
rwctl keys create --org-id 0xabc123 --project-slug nova-default --label "onboard-novatech-2026-03-15"
# verify
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models | jq .
```
If you want us to create it for you now, we can.

nova_tech (customer): happy to have you create it — prefer not to poke around the Console. please create and email me the key.

jon (sre): digging into infra logs — provisioning lambda attempted to resolve `project_slug -> project_id` and the mapping table returned empty because the SCIM sync wrote `external_project_id` instead of `slug`. root cause: invite flow had a schema drift after a deploy last week (we changed the SCIM field name). I can run a small repair that duplicates the mapping for affected orgs. Will also add a one-off retry for the job.

maria (support): if you run the repair and retry, I can hold the customer's hand and confirm when key appears. jon can you estimate ETA?

jon (sre): ETA ~ 20 minutes. running: 
```
infractl repair-mappings --org 0xabc123 --fix-field external_project_id,slug --dry-run=false
# then retry job id 2026-03-15-8072
infractl jobs retry 2026-03-15-8072
```
I'll post back when retry finishes.

deploy-bot: Job 2026-03-15-8072: provision_api_key (org=0xabc123) started by jon.

jon (sre): retry finished — job status: FAILED -> RETRIED -> SUCCEEDED. provisioning created key id `k_01F4x7` and attached to project `nova-default`. I also created a mapping shim so future runs succeed.

deploy-bot: Job 2026-03-15-8072: provision_api_key completed successfully (duration 13s).

maria (support): I created a support-only API key record and emailed alice@novatech.com with the key and recommended rotate instructions. Please confirm it works on your side.

nova_tech (customer): confirmed — key arrived, curl now returns 200 and embeddings work. thanks! :tada:

lia (solutions): filing a follow-up GH issue to add a validation in the invite flow to prevent missing mapping; marking this org as affected for a broader migration cleanup.

jon (sre): postmortem action items: add schema validator to SCIM sync (PR incoming), alert on provisioning job missing mappings, and add a retry hook in the webhook queue.

maria (support): closing from support side once we see customer's last_message_ts >= now. leaving thread open for internal follow-ups.

nova_tech (customer): all good here, appreciate the fast turnaround.
